name: Puffed fried sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice fried so it puffs, on the Cồn Phụng lunch list beside the garden plates. No recipe was printed. The plate shown was not taken on the islet. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Named on the Cồn Phụng lunch list. The plate shown is xôi chiên, and that table is not placed on the islet.
howToEat: It is one of the lunch plates on the garden table at Cồn Phụng, with đuông dừa fried in butter, cá tai tượng chiên xù, lẩu mắm, cơm trái dừa, and tép rang dừa. No recipe was printed for any of them.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: The garden table at Cồn Phụng. The plate shown is xôi chiên with pickled vegetables and a minced-meat bowl. That table is not the islet.
seoTitle: Xoi chien phong — puffed sticky rice at Ben Tre
seoDescription: Xôi chiên phồng is sticky rice fried so it puffs, on the Cồn Phụng lunch list. No recipe was printed. A stall price is check on arrival.
